name: Turbo Scaler Grid Pending EA
summary: This EA implements a grid trading strategy using pending orders that are placed at fixed intervals from the current price. It scales into positions by placing multiple buy and sell pending orders at predetermined distances, aiming to profit from price oscillations within a range. The 'Turbo Scaler' aspect suggests accelerated order placement with configurable grid spacing and lot sizing.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了一种网格交易策略，通过在当前价格的固定间隔处放置挂单来进行交易。它通过在预定距离处放置多个买入和卖出挂单来逐步建仓，旨在从价格区间震荡中获利。'Turbo Scaler'特性意味着加速下单，具有可配置的网格间距和手数设置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用网格挂单策略，核心概念是在当前价格上下方按固定间距布置多排买入和卖出挂单，利用市场波动在价格来回震荡时逐步获利。入场条件是基于预设的网格间距自动放置BUY STOP和SELL STOP挂单，无需技术指标信号触发，纯粹依赖价格触及网格线位来触发成交。出场条件主要通过止盈来平仓，每个网格订单设有独立的止盈目标，但止损设置可能不充分或缺失，这是网格策略的典型隐患。仓位管理采用可配置的手数参数，可能支持递增手数模式以在浮亏时加仓摊薄成本。资金管理方面，该EA依赖账户余额承受网格展开后的浮亏风险，缺乏整体风险敞口控制机制，在趋势行情中可能面临严重的资金回撤。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a grid pending order strategy where the core concept is placing multiple BUY STOP and SELL STOP orders at fixed intervals above and below the current price, profiting from market oscillations as price triggers successive grid levels. Entry conditions are purely mechanical: pending orders are placed automatically at predefined grid distances without any technical indicator signal, relying entirely on price reaching grid levels for order activation. Exit conditions primarily use take-profit targets for each individual grid order, but stop-loss settings may be inadequate or absent, which is a typical hazard of grid strategies. Position sizing uses configurable lot parameters and may support incremental lot sizing modes to average down costs during drawdowns. Money management depends on the account balance absorbing the floating loss risk from an expanded grid, lacking an overall risk exposure control mechanism that could lead to severe drawdowns in trending markets.

parameters.name: GridStep
parameters.description: 网格间距，相邻挂单之间的价格距离
parameters.description_en: Grid step, price distance between adjacent pending orders

parameters.name: MaxOrders
parameters.description: 最大挂单数量，限制单方向订单总数
parameters.description_en: Max pending orders, limits total orders per direction

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description: 初始手数，首笔订单的交易量
parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, first order volume

parameters.name: LotMultiplier
parameters.description: 手数倍增系数，后续网格订单的加仓倍数

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，每笔订单的盈利目标
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points per level

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，每笔订单的止损距离
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, SL distance per order

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术编号，EA订单的唯一标识
parameters.description_en: Magic number, unique EA order identifier

parameters.name: OrdersAbove
parameters.description: 上方挂单数，当前价格上方的买入挂单数量
parameters.description_en: Buy pending orders above current price

parameters.name: OrdersBelow
parameters.description: 下方挂单数，当前价格下方的卖出挂单数量
parameters.description_en: Sell pending orders below current price

pros: 网格策略在震荡行情中表现优异，能持续从小幅波动中累积利润
挂单模式避免了情绪化交易，系统化执行无需人工干预
多层级挂单提供了密集的市场覆盖，提高了成交概率和盈利频率
可配置参数丰富，交易者可以根据不同品种和市场条件灵活调整网格参数
双向挂单设计使得无论价格上行或下行都有机会获利
pros_en: Grid strategy excels in ranging markets, continuously accumulating profits from small price oscillations
Pending order mode eliminates emotional trading with systematic execution requiring no manual intervention
Multi-level pending orders provide dense market coverage, increasing fill probability and profit frequency
Rich configurable parameters allow traders to flexibly adjust grid settings for different instruments and market conditions
Bi-directional pending orders create profit opportunities regardless of price moving up or down
cons: 在单边趋势行情中网格会持续亏损加仓，可能导致爆仓风险
缺乏整体风险敞口控制，无法有效限制最大浮亏和总持仓量
止损设置可能不完善，个别订单甚至可能没有止损保护
资金需求较高，需要充足保证金来支撑网格全面展开后的浮亏
未考虑交易成本（点差、隔夜费）对网格利润的侵蚀效应
缺乏市场状态过滤机制，在任何行情条件下都机械地布置网格
cons_en: In trending markets the grid continuously adds losing positions, potentially leading to margin call and account blowout
Lacks overall risk exposure control with no effective limit on maximum floating loss or total position size
Stop-loss settings may be incomplete, with individual orders potentially lacking stop-loss protection entirely
High capital requirement demanding sufficient margin to sustain floating losses when the grid is fully expanded
Does not account for the erosion effect of trading costs (spreads, swap fees) on grid profitability
No market state filtering mechanism, mechanically deploying grids regardless of trending or ranging conditions
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如均线方向或ADX），在强趋势行情中暂停或减少网格布置
实现全局风险控制模块，设置最大浮亏限额和总仓位上限，触及阈值时自动平仓止损
添加动态网格间距功能，根据波动率（ATR）自适应调整网格密度
完善止损机制，为每笔订单强制设置止损，并增加账户级别的紧急止损功能
加入点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在高点差时段和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add trend filtering indicators (e.g., MA direction or ADX) to pause or reduce grid deployment during strong trending markets
Implement a global risk control module with maximum floating loss limits and total position caps, triggering automatic liquidation when thresholds are breached
Add dynamic grid spacing functionality that adaptively adjusts grid density based on volatility (ATR)
Improve stop-loss mechanisms by mandating stop-loss for every order and adding account-level emergency stop functionality
Add spread filtering and trading session controls to avoid trading during high-spread and low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 网格策略在趋势行情中可能无限加仓导致巨大浮亏甚至爆仓
缺乏强制止损和全局风险控制机制，账户安全高度依赖市场保持震荡
递增手数模式（如存在）会指数级放大风险敞口，加速账户亏损
未检测市场状态和波动率变化，在不利条件下仍持续布置网格
risk_points_en: Grid strategy may infinitely add positions in trending markets leading to massive floating losses or margin call
Lack of mandatory stop-loss and global risk control makes account safety entirely dependent on markets remaining range-bound
Incremental lot sizing (if present) exponentially amplifies risk exposure and accelerates account losses
No detection of market state or volatility changes, continuing grid deployment under adverse conditions
